title: Game freezes with an infinite flood of `Object was deleted while awaiting a callback` errors in both the editor and game build due to Control Nodes going bonkers.
body:
### Tested versions

4.4 (both the standard and mono) in forward+ and in compatibility modes.
(in the editor + in the editor play window + in game exported build)

### System information

Windows 11 - NVIDIA 566.36 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 - intel i5 13600kf

### Issue description

**EDIT: I've exported the game to a windows build and the game freezes too so it's not just in the editor and my game is pretty much unusable, working with control nodes in any way (expanding/shrinking/showing/hiding/...), or changing window size completely freezes the game indefinitely.**

When I make changes to Control elements godot editor and godot play window too (!) completely freezes flooding the output with `Object was deleted while awaiting a callback`.

This can happen whe nresizing the viewport, changing the size of control elements, changing their sizing, or just moving them in the scene tree, and ...

It happens to me all the time in my scene which is relatively simply when you look at it.

This happens all the time, the engine crashed on my about 30 times in 5 minutes and that was happening the whole day.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bbd052c5-72a1-4ae8-b7db-e0337f300f60)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1febb657-1ff8-49e6-b2fb-553c7fc215e0)

Video: https://youtu.be/SRhFDdtDpLs

I tried changing the memory limit in Project Settings for the message queue, but same issue.

### Steps to reproduce

In the MRP:
1. Open the Main/main_menu.tscn and go to the 2D view.
2. In the Scene tree select node near bottom called `SelectThisTextureRect`
3. Switch its expand mode to fit width porportionally.
4. Wait a second or two and then check the terminal and observe how the whole project gets unresponsive and you have to kill it.
(this issue can happen when just hidin showing some elements, changing their sizes, resizing window and so on, in the MRP I haven't reproduced it by resizing the game window but you can see it in my video and if needed I can also share the whole original with you so you can go and check the menu screen itself there if needed, just ping me in a message please.)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Godot freeze controls mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19427417/Godot.freeze.controls.mrp.zip)
